subject: Automate invoice creation + preferred delivery (email PDF + SFTP)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stellarmetrics.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: automate invoice creation & assign billing delegate

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well. We’re getting the procurement team ready to move forward and I need to confirm how invoices will be generated and delivered monthly. A couple of constraints on our side:

- Our AP team requires the PO number to be visible on every invoice (see attached SM_PO_7892.pdf).
- We can’t use new SSO integrations for the Redwood billing portal until our identity team approves it (likely a few weeks).
- Preferred delivery is either (a) consolidated monthly PDF emailed to procure@stellarmetrics.com plus cc to accounts-payable@stellarmetrics.com, or (b) nightly SFTP push with CSV line items.

Can Redwood auto-generate a consolidated invoice on day 1 of the month with PO and VAT fields populated? Also: what’s the simplest path to set up an AP contact so invoices stop going to my inbox?

Thanks — Elena

Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement | Stellar Metrics
Attachment: SM_PO_7892.pdf
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stellarmetrics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: automate invoice creation & assign billing delegate

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and the PO. We can support both delivery methods you mentioned; here are the tradeoffs and what we need from you: 

1) Email PDF (consolidated monthly):
- We can produce a single PDF invoice on the 1st of each month covering the prior month.
- PDF will include line items, PO, and your VAT number field.
- Delivery: send to up to two AP addresses and cc an internal billing alias if you want records copied to your team.

2) SFTP nightly CSV push:
- Good for AP systems that ingest files automatically. We push to a pre-configured SFTP endpoint (filename convention and CSV schema provided).
- Requires SFTP host, path, and user credentials (we can accept an SSH public key).

Action items we need from you to proceed:
- Confirm preferred primary delivery (EMAIL_PDF or SFTP).
- If EMAIL_PDF: confirm AP addresses to receive and whether to CC accounts-payable@stellarmetrics.com.
- If SFTP: provide endpoint details or let us create a temporary bucket for pickup.
- Please confirm the VAT number you want printed on invoices (and attach any VAT registration evidence if you prefer).

For transparency, I’ve attached our Redwood_Invoice_Template_v1.xlsx and a quick onboarding link: https://docs.redwood.ai/billing/email-sftp-delivery-guide.

Once you confirm, I’ll open a provisioning ticket with our finance ops team and loop Ben to set the automated cron for invoice creation.

Cheers,

— Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | billing@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Template_v1.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stellarmetrics.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@stellarmetrics.com
Date: Wed, 4 May 2027 15:08:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Request: automate invoice creation & assign billing delegate

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks, we’ll go with a hybrid: primary delivery via EMAIL_PDF to procure@stellarmetrics.com (please CC accounts-payable@stellarmetrics.com) and nightly SFTP drops to sftp.stellarmetrics.com/upload for our internal reconciliation system.

SFTP details below:
- Host: sftp.stellarmetrics.com
- Path: /upload/invoices/redwood
- We will provide an SSH public key via a secure channel (do you accept keys via DocuSign?).

VAT number: EU123456789 (attached evidence).
PO requirement: please ensure PO number is both on the invoice header and repeated in each line item row of the CSV.

I’ve attached the signed PO and VAT evidence. Let me know if you need anything else to start the cron.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: PO_7892_signed.pdf, Stellar_VAT_record.pdf
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: automate invoice creation & assign billing delegate

Following up internally — thanks for the details, team. Summary of next steps and owners: 

- Ben: please create automation ticket to generate consolidated monthly PDF on the 1st and enable nightly SFTP push using the schema in Redwood_Invoice_Template_v1.xlsx. Include PO on header and line items. Attach sftp_config_instructions.txt to the ticket. (Due: 2027-05-12)
- Stephanie: hold off on sending any test invoices until AP provides the SSH public key via secure channel. When key received, run a single-week trial push and confirm file naming matches Stellar’s ingestion rules.
- Laura: I will send a one-time billing alias invite to procure@stellarmetrics.com so invoices are delivered to the shared mailbox rather than Elena personally.

Ben, please confirm when the provisioning ticket is created (include HubSpot deal SM-7892 in the ticket).

Thanks,
Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
